## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dorchester, United Kingdom. It starts at Lodmoor Country Park.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get your SEA LIFE Weymouth tickets and explore an amazing underwater world. Inside there are over 2,000 marine creatures, including perfectly playful otters and rescued sea turtles. You can also meet the world's tiniest, cutest penguins at Fairy Penguin Island – it's the only colony outside Australia.
>
> Don't miss the state-of-the-art Night & Day attraction, where you can dance along the biofluorescent tropical shore and then journey underwater, surrounded by blacktip reef sharks, green sea turtles, and a beautiful array of tropical fish species.
>
> Find out how it feels to touch a starfish and other creatures in the interactive rock pool. With fun daily talks and animal feeds, trails, and special events throughout the year, there’s plenty to see!
>
> If all that animal magic isn't enough, stop by Caribbean Cove and climb the Galleon, Dorset's greatest adventure playground.

## Where this page comes from
